data.body:
Close-out verification against merged change 2369 / commit 9e0a979b30e7:
- tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py passed (4 passed).
- LOC measured at commit: gitutil.py 373 lines, git_locking.py 484 lines (both in 200-500 target).
- AST/difflib check found every moved function body byte-identical to the old gitutil body; retained gitutil executable AST after excluding moved names equals the old retained AST (docstring/import/re-export changes only).
- Relevant suites passed before split (42 passed at 9e0a979^), and after split (38 passed for the touched lock tests).
- grep over monkeypatch.setattr/getattr string sites confirmed moved-reader patches retargeted to git_locking, stayed-reader patches left on gitutil, and actual getattr(gitutil, "_INDEX_LOCK_STALE_S", default) reads still resolve via re-export.
- Import sweep imported 513 rebar modules without error; make lint and make typecheck both passed on origin/main.
AC boxes ticked based on this evidence.
